annotation_policy.primary_study_type: The dominant evidentiary design of the article, using the router's existing label set.
annotation_policy.secondary_modalities: Non-exclusive study modalities explicitly present in the title or abstract.
annotation_policy.has_structured_results: True only when the abstract has an explicit RESULTS or CONCLUSION(S) heading.
annotation_policy.high_extraction_complexity: True when reliable extraction must reconcile several experimental modalities, populations, causal layers, or many interacting entities/relations; length alone is insufficient.
annotation_policy.recommended_route: Gold routing recommendation before candidate extraction: FAST, STANDARD, or DEEP.

documents.title: Hydrogel-Based Immunomodulation of Tumor Immune Microenvironment in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Current Strategies and Future Directions.
documents.rationale: The abstract explicitly says 'This review explores' and 'This review highlights'; it reports no new cohort or experiment. Statements about demonstrated synergy summarize prior work and must not be treated as findings of this article.

documents.title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking for exploring the mechanism of Hedyotis diffusa against hepatitis B virus infection.
documents.rationale: All targets and mechanisms are generated from databases, enrichment and docking. The conclusion calls the work preliminary and asks for subsequent experiments; no wet-lab validation is reported. It is structurally complex but its claims need a strict prediction-only boundary.

documents.title: Association of nitrogen dioxide with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in Chinese rural older adults: The mediating role of fasting plasma glucose.
documents.rationale: This is baseline analysis of 3,662 human participants with measured/estimated exposure, ultrasound diagnosis, regression and mediation. It supports association and partial mediation, not experimental causation.

documents.title: Cartilage Intermediate Layer Protein 2 Aggravates Hepatic Lipid Accumulation and Inflammation Through the IRE1α/XBP1 Pathway.
documents.rationale: The dominant causal evidence comes from high-fat-diet mice, liver overexpression and knockout, supplemented by in-vitro hepatocytes and inhibitor rescue. It is mechanistic but must remain non-human evidence.

documents.title: Identification of CCND1 and IL7R as core JAK-STAT pathway genes promoting hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis.
documents.rationale: The study begins with GEO/WGCNA/ML/MR/scRNA analyses but ends with Western blot and qPCR validation in HBV-related fibrotic human liver tissues. Calling it merely computational would discard the decisive validation layer.

documents.title: Comparison of the efficacy of antidiabetic agents in type 2 diabetes with MASLD: a network meta-analysis.
documents.rationale: This is a systematic network meta-analysis of 21 previously published randomized trials and 15 agents. It contains quantitative synthesis but no new patient-level intervention performed by the article authors.

documents.title: Prophylactic Antibiotic Use and Clinical Outcomes in Patients With Child-Pugh A Cirrhosis and Acute Variceal Bleeding: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
documents.rationale: The authors retrospectively compare 237 Child-Pugh A patients who did or did not receive early prophylactic antibiotics. Outcomes are direct human observations, but treatment assignment was not randomized.

documents.title: Impact of Spheroid Use for Identifying Hepatocellular Carcinoma Features: Involvement of Kinase-Mediated Molecular Pathways.
documents.rationale: Although the subject is 3D in-vitro spheroids, the abstract explicitly says 'This review highlights' and reports no newly performed experiment. Topic modality must not replace article design.

documents.title: High Dihydromyricetin Loaded Biomimetic Nanoemulsion Ameliorated Early Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease by Hepatic Ferroptosis Inhibition.
documents.rationale: The work combines nanoemulsion characterization, absorption, biodistribution, pharmacokinetics and safety with therapeutic testing in a high-fat-diet NAFLD mouse model and a ferroptosis mechanism claim.

documents.title: Functional Role of COP1 Gene in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Lipid Metabolism and Stemness.
documents.rationale: The primary interventions are COP1 siRNA silencing and overexpression in several human HCC cell lines, followed by RNA sequencing and phenotypic assays. GEPIA2 clinical-sample correlation is supportive rather than the dominant design.
